census.scope: Captured Entity.move(DDD)V particle invocations on phase owner; World.getCollisions body only
census.caveats: Entry offsets precede cobweb scaling. Positive stepHeight is eligibility only; step_query_returns observes the step call site returning, not step success. Axis scan sums are structural 3*N/7*N estimates for normally returned moves with known lists, not measured clip counts. Unknown lists are not queried. Times are instrumented host wall, not CPU. Rest includes clipping, callbacks, fire checks and probes. Nested moves have inclusive overlapping times; nested same-move gather clocks use their union. HEAD/RETURN cannot unwind exceptions; boundary cleanup reports incomplete scopes. Reject anomalous captures. Hooks before first phase(null) are ignored, not included in excluded count. No allocation/byte counts measured.
